summary: A reconcile pass reads only the work wakes sent to an agent since its last pass, not the body of every message the agent was ever sent

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change; the query uses the existing message recipient index.

compatibility.detail: The same wakes, in the same order, with the same statuses; each is still checked against its current message view.

recovery.detail: Swapping back to an older build restores the full read; the kept subjects are in memory only.
